limitations: Development verification does not establish official evaluation correctness.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
implementation: TopModule has one-bit d, ena, and q. An always @(*) block intentionally infers a D latch: q follows d when ena is high and retains its stored value otherwise. No reset, initialization, extra ports, or pipeline latency.
skill_exceptions: The original problem explicitly requires a latch using an always block, overriding the skill's generic latch-avoidance and always_comb conventions. Original module name and ports are preserved.
testbench: Independent directed checks cover initial uninitialized storage, transparent data transitions, enable opening and closing, retention of both values, and repeated operation; includes fatal mismatch checks and bounded timeout.
static_review: Single procedural driver; one-bit ports; intentional incomplete assignment for latch storage; nonblocking assignment; initial snapshot preserved before checks.
